title: Which studies reached the page?
hook: Inspect every study, then inspect only the estimates that get displayed.

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: hide studies with null results and the published average effect inflates.

misconception: Treating publication funnel as valid without checking the stated model, denominators or causal assumptions.
objective: hide studies with null results and the published average effect inflates.
keyState: Both finite cases completed; their computed summaries retained.

claims.text: Five equally weighted studies estimate −2,−1,0,1,2. If only estimates at least 1 are shown, what mean estimate is visible?

claims.text: This finite funnel demonstrates a mechanism, not a measured rate of publication bias. Real evidence synthesis must investigate selection, study precision and heterogeneity rather than assume every missing result is zero.
